_comment: Known pre-existing violations. The gate FAILS on any file NOT listed here (no new debt) and ALSO fails if a listed file stops violating (stale entry), so this list can only shrink. Regenerate with scripts/ratchet.py lint --update — and review the diff before committing it.
_why: Pre-existing ruff findings, concentrated in app/skills/builtin.py (unsorted imports and blank-line whitespace) plus two unused imports in app/routers/. Fixing builtin.py's findings is entangled with reformatting 339 lines of it, which is too large to fold into a tooling change. The ratchet keeps them visible and blocks new ones; the list can only shrink.
